title: Self-Contained Jupyter Notebooks Pipeline for Colab GPU Training

ears_requirements.system_response: provide standalone Jupyter Notebooks in notebooks/ representing the complete AlignForge English training pipeline
ears_requirements.full_statement: THE SYSTEM SHALL provide standalone Jupyter Notebooks in notebooks/ representing the complete AlignForge English training pipeline.

ears_requirements.system_response: implement all tokenizer, model, cache, LoRA, DPO, guardrails, and evaluation logic via 1:1 copied code cells from src/ without importing from alignforge
ears_requirements.full_statement: THE SYSTEM SHALL implement all tokenizer, model, cache, LoRA, DPO, guardrails, and evaluation logic via 1:1 copied code cells from src/ without importing from alignforge.

ears_requirements.system_response: enable autonomous training on Google Colab with T4 GPU acceleration using device-agnostic PyTorch execution
ears_requirements.full_statement: THE SYSTEM SHALL enable autonomous training on Google Colab with T4 GPU acceleration using device-agnostic PyTorch execution.

ears_requirements.trigger: a user runs the notebook cells on Google Colab
ears_requirements.system_response: execute base pretraining, LoRA SFT, DPO alignment, and guardrailed generation producing valid checkpoints
ears_requirements.full_statement: WHEN a user runs the notebook cells on Google Colab THE SYSTEM SHALL execute base pretraining, LoRA SFT, DPO alignment, and guardrailed generation producing valid checkpoints.

ears_requirements.trigger: the test suite inspects all notebook files
ears_requirements.system_response: verify valid notebook JSON syntax, python compile validity of all code cells, and zero import references to alignforge
ears_requirements.full_statement: WHEN the test suite inspects all notebook files THE SYSTEM SHALL verify valid notebook JSON syntax, python compile validity of all code cells, and zero import references to alignforge.

bdd_scenarios.name: Zero dependency on alignforge package
bdd_scenarios.when: The code cells are inspected for module imports
then: No cell contains 'import alignforge' or 'from alignforge'
All required classes and functions are defined directly within notebook cells

bdd_scenarios.name: Executable training flow on Google Colab
given: A Google Colab environment with T4 GPU
bdd_scenarios.when: The training notebook is executed sequentially
then: CUDA device is detected and utilized for tensor computations
Checkpoints for C0, C1-lora, and C2-dpo are exported

bdd_scenarios.name: Automated syntax and structure verification
bdd_scenarios.when: Each notebook is parsed as JSON and code cells are compiled via python compile()
then: All notebooks parse without syntax errors

non_functional_constraints: Strictly zero imports from alignforge in notebooks
Device-agnostic execution supporting both CPU and CUDA T4 GPU
